This application under Section 482 CrPC has been filed by the applicants with the prayer to quash the order dated 7.1.2021 as well as further proceedings of Complaint Case No. 1163 of 2021 (State vs.
Krishna Kumar @ Dadu and another), under Sections 26(2) (ii), (i), (V)/59(i), 58 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District- Jaunpur, pending in the court of Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate-I, Jaunpur.

State of U.P. reported in 2004 (57) ALR 290 as well as judgement passed by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Lal Kamlendra Pratap Singh Vs. State of U.P. reported in 2009 (3) ADJ 322 (SC).
